I remember when we did this (in a smaller scale of course) back in the FidoNET times. Lots of DOS Users where using Crosspoint. And to communicate in the FidoNET, it was comfortable to have a Nodelist. Nodelists contained all Nodes of the FidoNET. These were basically Mailbox Systems exchanging all the Mails with each other in a pretty organized way. Users of the FidoNET were called Points by the way (I still remember my address :->).

So, what did we do? When you purchased one of those riduculously big new Hard Drives when they came out (like a 120MB drive), the first thing you did was creating one single file filling up the whole drive with just 0 or 1. It was just important to have a single file which just contains the same. Then compressed it to nearly nothing... and the last step involved to rename that file to what the Nodelist diff files normaly where named like.

And then you sent it to your friends :-)

What happened then? They polled their new Mails from their Node and as soon as Crosspoint was receiving the fake nodelist diff file it started to extract it. This pretty quickly filled up the HDDs of your mates and you were sure to get some hatemail in your next polling cycle... or another Mail bomb (that´s what we called it back then) from someone else who went out and purchased a bigger HDD than you had :-)

Pretty fun times... and no harm was done, because it did not destroy any data or produced data loss. It just took ages to merge that "node diff" file until their HDDs gave up :-)

Ha! Great to hear that someone else still remembers :-) Some of those Fidonet messages were still accessible back then when deja.com was around before Google bought it. I remember when my Node offered the option to access Usenet via a Fidonet <--> Usenet gateway. That was pretty exciting, because there was no Internet around apart from Universities. Interesting times... when you heard by the connect tone of your modem how much bandwidth you got this time, hehe :-)

Ahh... the old and simple days. I miss the hell out of dial-up BBS.

Relevant and awesome documentary with the FidoNet creators and early node operators: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Cm6EFYktRQ
That´s awesome! Thank you very much. I´ve never seen this... but I will in the next 44 minutes :-)

First post here on Voat, so I figure Ill get high and share some quality content. This is a recipe Ive been working on for a little bit and it's as delish as it is potent. The size and shape of your cookies are really up to you but I'd suggest making them about as big as the store bought ones for dosing reasons. Too big and it's hard to make smaller doses for lower tolerances. Feel free to comment with any better methods you know or any questions, Im always trying to get better.

Ingredients Amount
Eggs 2
Peanut butter (creamy is better unless you like crunchy) 3 cups
Butter 1 1/2 cups
Vanilla Extract A dash
White Sugar 1 Cup
Brown Sugar (packed) 1 Cup
Powdered Sugar Something like 3 cups (it's not measured)
Flour 2 1/2 Cups
Baking Powder 1 Teaspoon
Baking Soda 1 Teaspoon
Salt 1 Teaspoon
Weed Up to you but I like to use around a gram or so per oz of butter
Equipment Amount
Stovetop 1
Oven 1
Pot 1
Mixing Bowl 1
Metal Bowl 1
Bowl (smoking) 1 is preferred but not required
Cookie Tray 1
Tupperware (something for molten butter) 1
Strainer (or cheesecloth Ive heard) 1 (this is very important if you dont want ass tasting cookies)

Step 0. Preheat your oven to 220. When its ready put your weed on the cookie tray evenly spaced out and grinded up as much as possible then put them on a middle rack for around 40-50 minutes. This is decarbing weed and it converts cannabanoids into THC since cannabanoids are not fat soluble and will get lost anyways.

  1. Have a quick toke, you deserve it buddy. Then pull the weed out of the oven, the weed should come out light brown and toasted looking.

  2. Get a stove and bring two pots of water to a boil (the ones you'd use for ramen or soup). Lower the heat to where they are just simmering.

  3. Put the metal bowl on top of the pot so they get heat from the steam but not the stove top. You are now double boiling, youre just a regular Elzar. Put the butter into the bowl and let it soften. Add when when it's soft. Id use around 3/4 oz for the butter amount Im using.

  4. Mix the butter weed slurry around so that all the weed is covered in butter and stir occasionally.

  5. This step is a little grey because you tend to get high from standing over the slurry and I tend to smoke a lot but you stir and keep them on the stove for around 40 minutes. Some will say less time and keep an eye on it to keep the chlorophyll out but we are going to wash our butter so fuck it, get high and just chill.

  6. Now we get to wash the butter. This pulls out the chlorophyll since it is water soluble but leaves the THC since it is not. (This is also how you can turn garlic herb butter into regular butter if you wanted to do that for some reason) Pour a couple of cups of water into the slurry and mix it around. Do this for a couple minutes. You want the water to start to pick up a green color to it.

  7. Once that's done, get out the strainer and strain the weed out of the slurry as you pour it into the tupperware containers. Press the strained out weed as much as possible, all the dank butter is in there.

  8. Now you have a tupperware container of water/butter. What good is that? None. Throw it in the fridge over night for the two to separate. As a bonus this will also pull out all the plant material that got through the strainer.

  9. Good Morning! (or afternoon if you sleep in you lazy stoner) Go check on your butter. It should be yellow on top and green water on the bottom. Using a knife pull the butter puck out. That shit on the bottom is normal. Its kief like material caught in the butter.

  10. Well the hard part is done now. Its just baking now. Preheat your oven to 375 for the cookies.

Cookies

Ingredient Amount
Butter 1 cup or 2/3 the puck you made
Peanut Butter 1 cup
Eggs 2
Flour 2 1/2 cups
White Sugar 1 Cup
Brown Sugar 1 Cup
Baking Powder 1 teaspoon
Baking Soda 1 1/2 teaspoon
Salt a pinch

Combine the wet ingredients and dry separately and mix. Then slowly mix them together by adding the dry to wet slowly as you stir. When you get a good batter, roll it into little balls and evenly space them out on the cookie sheet. They will melt into cookie shapes so no worries. Bake them for around 10 minutes. Which is enough time to make...

Cookie Filling

Ingredient Amount
Peanut Butter 1 1/2 Cups
Butter 1/2 Cup or 1/3 of the puck
Vanilla Extract 1 Teaspoon
Salt A dash
Powdered Sugar More than you would think

Soften the butter in the microwave or stove, then mix all the ingredients except the powdered sugar together. Then slowly mix the powdered sugar in until you get the desired consistency. Then make your nutter butters and put them in the fridge for a little to harden up the filling and you are done!
